item.body:
### Summary
As a reader user, I want a tap on a rehosted picture whose link is a viewer page to open the right thing, so that #912 treats `reho.st` links correctly. The corpus has no capture showing what `reho.st/view/self/<hash>.<ext>` (the link around a `/preview/` or `/medium/` thumbnail) serves, nor an extension-less full image `reho.st/self/<hash>` (the rewrite target of `/thumb/`). Until captured, #912 (PR #1279) treats a `reho.st` link around a picture as a page link (with the external-page warning), except that a `reho.st/thumb/…` picture with a same-host link takes the `.viewer` exception (no corpus case).

### Scope
- Cookie-less GET (with and without the `Referer: https://forum.hardware.fr/`) of: `http(s)://reho.st/view/self/<hash>.png`, `.../medium/self/<hash>.jpg`, `.../self/<hash>`, `.../preview/self/<hash>`, using hashes from the anonymized corpus (R122c holds four `view` links).
- Record per URL: status, `Content-Type`, whether the body is an image or an HTML page, redirects.
- Result goes to `docs/HFR-PROTOCOL.md` (image hosts section) and to `ImageHostTable` data if a path shape is an image.

### Acceptance
- Each URL above has a recorded answer, anonymized, in the captures corpus or the protocol doc.
- If `/view/self/…` serves an image, #912's `ReaderPictureTap.imagePathPrefix` gets a `reho.st` shape; otherwise the page-link route stays.

### Sources
- Corpus: `Packages/HFRKit/Tests/HFRParsingTests/Fixtures/captures/R122c-topic-search-filter-checked.html` (`reho.st/view/self/…` around `/preview/` and `/medium/` thumbnails).
- #912, PR #1279, review round 1 finding 2.
